content.comment_body: Dear Expert, I am part of the Building Technologies division as a technical specialist. I have worked with [product_name] multiple times, mainly with the KNX and [product_name] modules. The Modbus TCP/IP feature, which is new to [product_name], prompts me to ask whether it is possible to connect to third-party BMS/SCADA software that has a built-in Modbus driver. Our Building Technologies software is called [product_name] CC. If [product_name] can connect to external BMS/SCADA platforms, it could greatly benefit the market for both [product_name] and our BMS solution. Looking forward to your response. Thank you for your support.

The answer is both yes and no. If the software works with [version_no], you can similarly configure a connection with [product_name]. However, if your software is not compatible with [company_name] [version_no], connecting is not possible. P.S. You might want to try out [product_name] Web Editor, which is available at no cost and provides an intuitive HMI setup via IP.

That's great news! Our software is fully compatible with [version_no] controllers like [version_no]. It offers a driver for [version_no] connectivity. We'll need to perform some tests to verify the setup. Thanks.

Here’s a helpful resource: [url] This is from a previous discussion; if you configure your [product_name] project accordingly, the BMS/SCADA software will detect the connection as a [version_no] PLC. You already have the necessary driver.

analysis.insight_summary: Users are investigating how [product_name] can integrate with external BMS/SCADA systems—particularly through Modbus TCP/IP and S7 communication. They discuss whether [product_name] can function as a Modbus server and be recognized by non-[company_name] management software, emphasizing the potential for integration when the third-party systems support S7 PLC communication protocols. Users express optimism about [product_name]'s compatibility in these scenarios, though specific details about Modbus server capability are not conclusively addressed.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect [product_name] to enable connectivity with third-party BMS/SCADA platforms using either Modbus protocol or S7 drivers. The main goal is to achieve dependable, straightforward integration and enhance interoperability.
